test_runs.command: pnpm --filter @colortrace/web exec vitest run test/response-plan-review.test.tsx test/incident-workspace-app.test.tsx

threats.control: Only a verified, unexpired human with the exact incident membership and role can create, edit, approve, or reject; preauthorization occurs before canonical authority registration.
Every mutation compares the current incident version, plan version, and plan hash transactionally; cross-connection approval is serialized.

Approval and dispatch bind the immutable incident, packet, deterministic scope, exact targets, protected exclusions, typed commands, action envelope, unresolved acknowledgement, actor, and idempotency key.
evidence: packages/web/test/response-plan-review.test.tsx::renders the complete shared envelope, command fields, and exact uncertainty IDs
packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::requires exact confirmation and sends immutable bindings before approval

threats.control: A typed edit creates a new immutable version, links its predecessor, invalidates prior approval and unconsumed authorization, and returns to pending review.
evidence: packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::makes an approved-plan edit immutable and visibly returns it to pending review

threats.control: Dispatch authorization requires the current approved decision; rejected, unapproved, blocking, or unknown scope cannot dispatch.
evidence: packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::renders rejected plans as decided and exposes no dispatch control

threats.control: A logical request key replays only its authoritative exact result, conflicting reuse fails, duplicate authorization is prohibited, and dispatch consumption is once-only.
Append-only audit events reconcile against immutable records and a trusted head; tampering, rewind, orphan records, schema drift, and restart replay are verified or rejected.

The browser renders all approval-relevant values as inert text, requires a keyboard-safe second confirmation, retains the same idempotency key for ambiguous retry, never replays an accepted mutation during reconciliation, and prevents cross-incident result projection.
evidence: packages/web/test/response-plan-review.test.tsx::renders exact immutable bindings and keeps command text inert
packages/web/test/response-plan-review.test.tsx::traps dialog focus, cancels with Escape, and restores the originating action
packages/web/test/incident-workspace-app.test.tsx::retries an ambiguous approval with the retained logical-action idempotency key
packages/web/test/incident-workspace-app.test.tsx::reports post-commit refresh failure separately and reconciles without replay
packages/web/test/incident-workspace-app.test.tsx::cannot project an old incident mutation completion into a newly selected plan
packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::retries an ambiguous approval with one retained idempotency key
packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::reconciles an accepted approval without replaying it after refresh failure
packages/web/e2e/incident-workspace.spec.ts::passes automated WCAG A and AA checks for the prepared workspace
